hypotheses.statement: The text is rendered but fully transparent (opacity 0) or hidden via visibility:hidden.
hypotheses.prediction: Both versions will show the text element with effectiveOpacity 0 or style.visibility 'hidden' at the reported viewport.
hypotheses.falsifier: At least one version shows effectiveOpacity > 0 and style.visibility 'visible' for the text element.

hypotheses.statement: The text is rendered but covered by an opaque overlay (e.g., a modal or banner) at the same rect.
hypotheses.prediction: Both versions will have an element covering the entire rect of the text with backgroundColor not fully transparent.
hypotheses.falsifier: No element covers the text rect in either version, or all covering elements have fully transparent backgrounds.

hypotheses.statement: The text is rendered but outside the viewport due to incorrect layout (e.g., negative margin, transform, or overflow).
hypotheses.prediction: Both versions will show the text element with rect.x or rect.y outside the viewport bounds (x < 0 or y < 0 or x+width > viewport width or y+height > viewport height).
hypotheses.falsifier: The text element rect is fully within viewport bounds in at least one version.

probe.question: Is the text element visible, uncovered, and within the viewport in both versions?
probe.falsifier: Any version fails to meet the visibility, coverage, or bounds criteria.
controls: Use the same viewport for both versions to ensure comparability.
Measure the rendered text element's rect, effectiveOpacity, visibility, and covering elements at the exact reported viewport.
limitations: Does not account for dynamic content changes after initial render.
Assumes the text element is uniquely identifiable by its content; if multiple matches exist, behavior is undefined.
